function.name: searchSuppliers
function.description: Search for existing suppliers by name or registration key. Returns matching entities with their IDs, names, and countries.

query.description: Search query to match against supplier names or registration keys

function.name: listCategories
function.description: List all available expense categories. These are user-facing labels that map to accounting accounts and VAT codes.

function.name: getClassificationMemory
function.description: Get historical category usage for a specific supplier. Shows what categories this supplier's expenses have been classified as in the past.

function.name: previewCategoryMapping
function.description: Preview what accounting account and VAT code would be used for a given category and supplier context.

function.name: getClassificationContext
function.description: Deep read for triage: from document evidence (supplier registration key, name, country, goods-vs-services) and a candidate category, resolve or propose the supplier, gather its classification memory, and preview the resulting account + VAT code mapping. Call this ONCE instead of chaining searchSuppliers, getClassificationMemory, and previewCategoryMapping.

category.description: The user-facing category label to preview

evidence.description: Document evidence about the supplier extracted from the markdown

registrationKey.description: Supplier strong registration key (e.g. VAT number / DK CVR) read from the document.

name.description: Supplier name as printed on the document.

country.description: Supplier ISO country code read from the document.
